agent_explanation: Shrunk to 1 body (e=1, m=1, r=0.833, vx=43.86) with no walls (arena boundary only). Energy is conserved until the high-speed impact with the right arena wall between step 137 and 138. Speed jumps from 43.89 to 49.07 (vx magnitude 43.86 -> 49.04) despite e=1 which should be elastic (conserve kinetic energy), increasing total mechanical energy from ~1054 J to 1294.6 J, exceeding E0*1.10+5=1164.4 J. Likely cause is the wall collision/positional-correction logic adding energy when correcting penetration at high incident velocity with split substeps (2 substeps in step 138), effectively injecting kinetic energy instead of reflecting it.
